providers.name: Google Places
providers.id_description: Opaque Google Maps Platform identifier for a place. LMID accepts identifiers of 1 to 256 characters without truncation.
providers.notes: The agreed LMID provider slug is google-places. Google documents variable-length IDs without a maximum; LMID still limits this field to 256 characters. No fixed prefix or stable validation regex is assumed. IDs can change, and a place can have multiple IDs. Bind the ID to a local property record; it does not identify an internal building or flat by itself. Listing is parsing guidance, not Google participation in LMID or issuer trust.

providers.name: DIGIPIN
providers.id_description: Ten-character India Post coordinate-derived grid identifier. Separators used for display are not semantically significant.
providers.notes: Identifies a geographic grid cell, not a property, tower, floor, or unit. Example is illustrative and must be replaced by an accurately computed DIGIPIN in real passes.

providers.name: OpenStreetMap
providers.id_description: An OSM element type and positive integer ID, expressed as node/<id>, way/<id>, or relation/<id>.
providers.notes: Element type is mandatory because OSM element types have separate ID spaces. OSM IDs are useful references but are not guaranteed permanent identity anchors.

providers.name: what3words
providers.id_description: A what3words address written as three lowercase words separated by dots, with the leading three slashes retained.
providers.notes: Proprietary place-address provider. Implementers must follow the provider's current API, attribution, trademark, and licensing requirements.
